surface: Sidebar V2 controls and shared command palette

authority.primary: Current Web/Electron source in this checkout
authority.visualReference: Six user-supplied original T3 Code screenshots
authority.implementationRule: Web and Lynx must share product anatomy, presentation logic, keyboard semantics, and state transitions. Renderer-specific code is limited to host primitives and verified Lynx runtime gaps.
authority.motionRule: Every newly discovered screen or state transition must be traced to the Web/Electron source before Lynx implementation or certification. Record duration, easing, animated properties, enter and exit states, interruption behavior, and reduced-motion behavior; do not infer motion from a single screenshot.

panel.enter: scale 0.98 and opacity 0 to scale 1 and opacity 1
panel.exit: scale 1 and opacity 1 to scale 0.98 and opacity 0

commandPalette.verification: Native measurements and screenshots wait for consecutive stable box-model samples rather than a fixed delay, so the 200ms transition is not captured mid-frame.

sidebarActionTooltip.interruption: Leaving before the open delay cancels the pending tooltip; leaving an open tooltip dismisses it without a stale delayed reopen.

sidebarListReorder.purpose: Preserve row-to-thread continuity when project or thread ordering changes.

reducedMotion.contract: Lynx disables tooltip and command-palette spatial animation under prefers-reduced-motion while preserving the final visible state and interaction.

flows.entry: Open the flat Sidebar V2 with at least one project
assertions: The first 32px control row contains a left Search icon and label plus a trailing New thread icon button.
The second 32px control row contains a left folder icon, All projects label, trailing chevron, and a separate trailing New project icon button.
Both rows use the same 8px Sidebar inset and a 4px gap before the 32px trailing action.
Visible controls are the real interactive components, not screenshot or authority-image substitutes.

flows.entry: Hover or keyboard-focus the New thread icon
assertions: The 32px trigger shows the Sidebar hover material and foreground icon.
A right-side tooltip reads New thread followed by the configured shortcut when available.
Moving away or moving focus away dismisses the tooltip without leaving a stale delayed popup.

flows.entry: Activate New thread while more than one logical project is available
assertions: The shared command palette opens in the new-thread-projects view instead of creating in an arbitrary first project.
The input has a Back affordance and Search placeholder.
The Projects section lists every logical project with folder icon, title, workspace path, and shortcut hint where supported.
Hover and ArrowUp or ArrowDown update the same active row; Enter creates a thread associated with that project; Backspace returns; Escape or backdrop dismisses.

flows.entry: Hover or keyboard-focus the New project icon
assertions: The 32px trigger shows the Sidebar hover material and foreground icon.
A right-side tooltip reads New project.
Moving away or moving focus away dismisses the tooltip without leaving a stale delayed popup.
The same command palette opens in the add-project-sources view.
The Sources section contains Local folder, Git URL, GitHub repository, Azure DevOps repository, Bitbucket repository, and GitLab repository.
Unavailable providers are disabled and visibly marked Setup Required.
Hover and ArrowUp or ArrowDown update the same active row; Enter selects; Backspace returns; Escape or backdrop dismisses.
The same command palette opens in the root view with Search commands, projects, and threads placeholder.
Actions and Recent Threads use the shared section and row composition.
Hover and ArrowUp or ArrowDown update the same active row; Enter executes; Escape or backdrop dismisses.
The footer advertises only keyboard behavior that the current host actually accepts.

crossFlowInvariants: All palette views use one shared panel, search, result-row, disabled-row, active-row, and footer composition.
All hover and focus states have visible feedback and an observable reverse state.
New thread selection preserves project-to-thread association.

Tooltip motion follows the Web authority: standalone Sidebar action tooltips use Base UI's 600ms open delay, thread-card previews use the explicit 150ms delay, and both dismiss immediately on leave with opacity plus scale transitions instead of layout animation.
Sidebar row and action disclosure follows the Web authority's opacity and color transitions; thread-list reordering uses the existing 150ms ease-out auto-animate contract.
Reduced-motion users receive the source-defined non-animated status and transition variants.
Every Browser or Native evidence loop must report agent-browser owned=0 orphaned=0 before and after.
Native physical keyboard claims require an authorized real OS input session; source tests or Browser CDP do not substitute for it.
resolvedBaselineLoss: The Lynx Search control previously collapsed to 16px while Web allocated the 203px primary slot; both now use the shared control-row primary slot.
The sidebar-flat-layout gate previously checked only broad geometry; it now verifies primary and trailing action slots, labels, and both hover surfaces.
Lynx New thread previously created directly in the first project; multi-project state now opens the shared project chooser.
